movies.overview: Newspaper magnate Charles Foster Kane is taken from his mother as a boy and made the ward of a rich industrialist. As a result, every well-meaning, tyrannical or self-destructive move he makes for the rest of his life appears in some way to be a reaction to that deeply wounding event.
movies.title: Citizen Kane
movies.tagline: Some called him a hero...others called him a heel.

movies.overview: Dumbo is a baby elephant born with over-sized ears and a supreme lack of confidence. But thanks to his even more diminutive buddy Timothy the Mouse,  the pint-sized pachyderm learns to surmount all obstacles.
movies.title: Dumbo
movies.tagline: The One...The Only...The FABULOUS...

movies.overview: A private detective takes on a case that involves him with three eccentric criminals, a beautiful liar, and their quest for a priceless statuette.
movies.title: The Maltese Falcon
movies.tagline: A story as EXPLOSIVE as his BLAZING automatics!

movies.overview: A sheltered heiress falls for a charming playboy and elopes with him, but soon discovers his gambling vice and mounting debts. As his lies deepen and those around them meet mysterious ends, she begins to suspect that her husband’s affection may conceal a deadly motive—and that she could be his next victim.
movies.title: Suspicion
movies.tagline: In his arms she felt safety...in his absence, haunting dread!

movies.overview: Huw Morgan, the academically inclined youngest son in a proud family of Welsh coal miners, witnesses the tumultuous events of his young life during a period of rapid social change. At the dawn of the 20th-century, a miners' strike divides the Morgans: the sons demand improvements, and the father doesn't want to rock the boat.
movies.title: How Green Was My Valley
movies.tagline: Rich is their humor! Deep are their passions! Reckless are their lives! Mighty is their story!

movies.overview: As a parting shot, fired reporter Ann Mitchell prints a fake letter from unemployed "John Doe," who threatens suicide in protest of social ills. The paper is forced to rehire Ann and hires John Willoughby to impersonate "Doe." Ann and her bosses cynically milk the story for all it's worth, until the made-up "John Doe" philosophy starts a whole political movement.
movies.title: Meet John Doe
movies.tagline: All America wants to meet the “Mr. Deeds” of 1941!

movies.overview: A married tugboat captain falls for a woman he rescues from a sinking ship.
movies.title: Stormy Waters
movies.tagline: A tempestuous love story in the great French style...!

movies.overview: Dr. Jekyll believes good and evil exist in everyone and creates a potion that allows his evil side, Mr. Hyde, to come to the fore. He faces horrible consequences when he lets his dark side run amok.
movies.title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
movies.tagline: It CHILLS you! Half-MAN! Half-MONSTER!

movies.overview: Shortly before the start of WW2, renowned British big-game hunter Alan Thorndike, vacationing in Bavaria, has Hitler in his gun sight. He is captured, beaten, left for dead, and escapes back to London where he is hounded by Nazi agents and aided by a young woman.
movies.title: Man Hunt
movies.tagline: One of the Most Gripping Scenes Ever Filmed...as two world-famous hunters stalk each Other!

movies.overview: Given a pardon from jail, Roy Earle gets back into the swing of things as he robs a swanky resort.
movies.title: High Sierra
movies.tagline: HE KILLED... and there on the crest of Sierra's highest crag... HE MUST BE KILLED!

movies.original_title: They Died with Their Boots On
movies.overview: The story follows General George Armstrong Custer's adventures from his West Point days to his death. He defies orders during the Civil War, trains the 7th Cavalry, appeases Chief Crazy Horse and later engages in bloody battle with the Sioux nation.
movies.title: They Died with Their Boots On
movies.tagline: A STORY OF UNDYING FAITH!

movies.overview: After his brother's death, Larry Talbot returns home to his father and the family estate. Events soon take a turn for the worse when Larry is bitten by a werewolf.
movies.title: The Wolf Man
movies.tagline: His hideous howl a dirge of death!

movies.overview: Olsen and Johnson, a pair of stage comedians, try to turn their play into a movie and bring together a young couple in love, while breaking the fourth wall every step of the way.
movies.title: Hellzapoppin'
movies.tagline: AT LAST IT'S ON THE SCREEN! Greater than the Stage Show!

movies.overview: A group of academics have spent years shut up in a house working on the definitive encyclopedia. When one of them discovers that his entry on slang is hopelessly outdated, he ventures into the wide world to learn about the evolving language. Here he meets Sugarpuss O’Shea, a nightclub singer, who’s on top of all the slang—and, it just so happens, needs a place to stay.
movies.title: Ball of Fire
movies.tagline: “I LOVE HIM because he doesn't know how to kiss—THE JERK!”

movies.overview: It's no accident when wealthy Charles falls for Jean. Jean is a con artist with her sights set on Charles' fortune. Matters complicate when Jean starts falling for her mark. When Charles suspects Jean is a gold digger, he dumps her. Jean, fixated on revenge and still pining for the millionaire, devises a plan to get back in Charles' life. With love and payback on her mind, she re-introduces herself to Charles, this time as an aristocrat named Lady Eve Sidwich.
movies.title: The Lady Eve
movies.tagline: When you deal a fast shuffle, love is in the cards.

movies.overview: A village in the French Alps is rocked by a series of crimes, including the theft of a sacred ring and the murder of a man dressed as Père Noël (Father Christmas).
movies.title: Who Killed Santa Claus?

movies.overview: A gambling queen uses blackmail to stop a British financier from closing her Chinese clip joint.
movies.title: The Shanghai Gesture
movies.tagline: Mystery-lure of the Far East!

movies.overview: Biff Grimes is desperately in love with Virginia, but his best friend Hugo marries her and manipulates Biff into becoming involved in his somewhat nefarious businesses. Hugo appears to have stolen Biff's dreams, and Biff has to deal with the realisation that having what he wants and wanting what another has can be very different things.
movies.title: The Strawberry Blonde
movies.tagline: Times have changed, but Cagney hasn't!

movies.overview: Successful movie director John L. Sullivan, convinced he won't be able to film his ambitious masterpiece until he has suffered, dons a hobo disguise and sets off on a journey, aiming to "know trouble" first-hand. When all he finds is a train ride back to Hollywood and a beautiful blonde companion, he redoubles his efforts, managing to land himself in more trouble than he bargained for when he loses his memory and ends up a prisoner on a chain gang.
movies.title: Sullivan's Travels
movies.tagline: Veronica Lake’s on the Take

movies.overview: In the early days of World War II, a German U-boat is sunk in Canada's Hudson Bay. Hoping to evade capture, a small band of German soldiers led by commanding officer Lieutenant Hirth attempts to cross the border into the United States, which has not yet entered the war and is officially neutral. Along the way, the German soldiers encounter brave men such as a French-Canadian fur trapper, Johnnie, a leader of a Hutterite farming community, Peter, an author, Philip and a soldier, Andy Brock.
movies.title: 49th Parallel
movies.tagline: THE MIGHTEST MANHUNT THAT EVER SWEPT THE SCREEN!

movies.overview: Alvin York a hillbilly sharpshooter transforms himself from ruffian to religious pacifist. He is then called to serve his country and despite deep religious and moral objections to fighting becomes one of the most celebrated American heroes of WWI.
movies.title: Sergeant York
movies.tagline: Missiles! Jets! Tanks! ... It's still the guy with guts and a gun who wins the war!

movies.overview: Volpone, an elderly Venetian, connives with his money-crazed servant to convince his greedy friends that he is dying, knowing that each will try to curry favor with him in order to be named his heir. He is inundated with valuable gifts, and soon finds himself entangled deeper and deeper in a web of lies.
movies.title: Volpone

movies.overview: In 1701, Lord Takuminokami Asano has a feud with Lord Kira and he tries to kill Kira in the corridors of the Shogun's palace. The Shogun sentences Lord Asano to commit suppuku and deprives the palace and lands from his clan, but does not punish Lord Kira. Lord Asano's vassals leave the land and his samurais become ronin and want to seek revenge against the dishonor of their Lord. But their leader Kuranosuke Oishi asks the Shogun to restore the Asano clan with his brother Daigaku Asano. One year later, the Shogun refuses his request and Oishi and forty-six ronin revenge their Lord.
movies.title: The 47 Ronin

movies.overview: In 1900, a clan attempts to strike a deal with a Chicago industrialist to get him to build cotton mills in their Deep South town.
movies.title: The Little Foxes
movies.tagline: ...the film version of the stage hit, as the ruthless beauty whose ambition spelt the doom of three men

movies.overview: A happily married woman sees a psychoanalyst and develops doubts about her husband.
movies.title: That Uncertain Feeling
movies.tagline: It's a serious problem for a lady with the hiccups, and he is it!

movies.overview: A detective is hired to protect the life of a singer, who has recently inherited a department store, from the store's crooked manager.
movies.title: The Big Store
movies.tagline: Gorgeous Girls! Uproarious Fun! The Big Musical Show!

movies.overview: Shipwrecked fugitives try to escape a brutal sea captain who's losing his mind.
movies.title: The Sea Wolf
movies.tagline: Jack London's great novel of terror afloat.

movies.overview: Paris, France. Commissaire Wens is put in charge of the investigation into the murder of one of six friends who, in the past, made a very profitable promise.
movies.title: The Last One of the Six

movies.overview: Humorist Robert Benchley attempts to find Walt Disney to ask him to adapt a short story about a gentle dragon who would rather recite poetry than be ferocious. Along the way, he is given a tour of Walt Disney Studios, and learns about the animation process.
movies.title: The Reluctant Dragon
movies.tagline: The big feature show with a thousand surprises!

movies.overview: Shiftless Jeeter Lester and his family of sharecroppers live in rural Georgia where their ancestors were once wealthy planters. Their slapstick existence is threatened by a bank's plans to take over the land for more profitable farming.
movies.title: Tobacco Road
movies.tagline: ON THE SCREEN AT LAST! The Picture you've waited eight years to see...Picturized by the men who gave you "GRAPES OF WRATH"

movies.overview: Donald has to get up early, but everything seems to be working to keep him awake. His loudly ticking alarm clock resists several attempts to quiet it. Donald ultimately swallows it; the glow-in-the-dark dial can be seen through his feathers. Then his folding bed folds up on him. Springs start popping out of it; Donald builds an elaborate framework to hold it down. Finally, enough of the clock reassembles itself to sound the alarm and night is over.
movies.title: Early to Bed
movies.tagline: A ticking alarm clock keeps Donald awake.

movies.overview: Happily married for three years, Ann and David Smith live in New York. One morning Ann asks David if he had to do it over again, would he marry her? To her shock, he answers, "No". Later that day, they separately discover that, due to a legal complication, they are not legally married.
movies.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
movies.tagline: Lombard and Montgomery Get Hitched As They're Getting Unhitched !

movies.overview: Young Matt Matthews, an Ozark Mountains moonshiner, hates the father he has never seen, who apparently deserted Matt's mother and left her to die. His obsession contributes to the hatred rampant in the mountains. However, the arrival of a stranger, Daniel Howitt, begins to positively affect the mountain people, who learn to shed their hatred under his gentle influence.
movies.title: The Shepherd of the Hills
movies.tagline: He Tamed Their Wild Hearts With His Courage and Won Them With His Love

movies.overview: A woman pretends to be her own twin sister to win back her straying husband.
movies.title: Two-Faced Woman
movies.tagline: Love-laughs explode all over the place when Garbo plays twin sisters, and Melvyn Douglas loves both of them!

movies.overview: A charming racketeer seduces the DA's stepdaughter for revenge, then falls in love.
movies.title: Johnny Eager
movies.tagline: They’re Dynamite

movies.overview: It's snowy and cold outside, and warm inside where Jerry squeezes past a mousetrap to cavort under a present-laden Christmas tree. Mistaking the sleeping Tom for a plush toy, Jerry wakes him and a mad chase ensues.
movies.title: The Night Before Christmas

movies.overview: Boxer Joe Pendleton, flying to his next fight, crashes...because a Heavenly Messenger, new on the job, snatched Joe's spirit prematurely from his body. Before the matter can be rectified, Joe's body is cremated; so the celestial Mr. Jordan grants him the use of the body of wealthy Bruce Farnsworth, who's just been murdered by his wife. Joe tries to remake Farnsworth's unworthy life in his own clean-cut image, but then falls in love; and what about that murderous wife?
movies.title: Here Comes Mr. Jordan
movies.tagline: A picture different from anything ever screened before!

movies.overview: When Edward Creighton leads the construction of the Western Union to unite East with West, he hires a Western reformed outlaw and a tenderfoot Eastern surveyor.  Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in partnership with Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation in 2000.
movies.title: Western Union
movies.tagline: A 20th Century-Fox Encore Hit !

movies.overview: Hank McHenry and Johnny Marshall work as power company linesmen. Hank is injured in an accident and subsequently promoted to foreman of the gang. Tensions start to show in the road crew as rivalry between Hank and Johnny increases.
movies.title: Manpower
movies.tagline: Raft and Robinson are at the brawling point!

movies.overview: The story of courtesan and dance-hall girl Emma Hamilton, including her relationships with Sir William Hamilton and Admiral Horatio Nelson and her rise and fall, set during the Napoleonic Wars.
movies.title: That Hamilton Woman
movies.tagline: The Year's Most Exciting Team of Screen Lovers!

movies.overview: A Japanese mountain inn patron's foot is cut by an ornamental hairpin accidentally left behind by a former patron, leading to much curiosity among the other patrons regarding her identity.
movies.title: Ornamental Hairpin

movies.overview: Julie and Roger are a love-struck married couple who desperately want to have a child. Tragedy after tragedy gets in their way, as the two attempt to rise above their troubles and fulfill their dreams of parenthood.
movies.title: Penny Serenade
movies.tagline: "Remember the tune they were singing the night we fell in love?..."

movies.overview: A female blackmailer with a disfiguring facial scar meets a plastic surgeon who offers her the possibility of looking like a normal woman.
movies.title: A Woman's Face
movies.tagline: HOW COULD THIS WOMAN WIN A MAN'S LOVE...HIS KISSES...HIS EMBRACES...?

movies.overview: A young promoter is accused of the murder of Vicky Lynn, a young actress he "discovered" as a waitress while out with ex-actor Robin Ray and gossip columnist Larry Evans.
movies.title: I Wake Up Screaming
movies.tagline: Three of the Hottest names in Hollywood... in a picture that makes the screen SIZZLE!

movies.overview: Donald decides to try cooking along with a radio show.
movies.title: Chef Donald
movies.tagline: Donald is inspired by a radio program to make waffles.

movies.overview: Bugs Bunny challenges slick Cecil Turtle to a race.
movies.title: Tortoise Beats Hare

movies.overview: A comedy of errors where floundering pediatrician Pietro takes a job as an orphanage health inspector to pay for the debts of his high-spending girlfriend Loletta, only to end up mistakenly engaged with Lilli, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, and pursued by lovestruck 18-year-old orphan Teresa Venerdì.
movies.title: Teresa Venerdì

movies.overview: A scientific expedition happens to discover that gold exists on Tarzan's escarpment. The villainous Medford and Vandermeer kidnap Jane and Boy to extort from Tarzan the location of the gold.
movies.title: Tarzan's Secret Treasure
movies.tagline: The Greatest Tarzan Is Back!

movies.overview: Jealous over Mickey's attention to a kitten, Pluto's devil-self argues with his angel-self over whether or not to rescue the kitten when it falls into a well.  The angel-self wins, and Pluto is treated like a hero.  In the end, he and the kitten become friends.
movies.title: Lend a Paw
movies.tagline: Pluto's jealousy of a kitten leaves him conflicted about rescuing it.

movies.overview: In the kingdom of Kindaor, traitor Sedesmondo kills his brother, the King of Kindaor, and becomes the tyrant of kingdom. He abandons the prince Arminio to beasts in the woods, but lions don't kill him and breed him as one of them.
movies.title: The Iron Crown
movies.tagline: LAVISH SSPECTACLE - Bigger than "Quo Vadis"..Greater than "Ben-Hur"..Gigantic Battle Scenes! Cast of 1,000's!
